What\'s encrypted, and why your recovery code matters
Yes. Each bookmark is encrypted on this device before it\'s uploaded. The server only ever stores scrambled data it can\'t read.
Can Firedown or anyone else read them?
No. Only your recovery code can unlock your bookmarks. They\'re encrypted end-to-end, nothing personal is attached, and the server never sees the unscrambled data.
A key generated on your device when you turn on sync. It\'s the one and only thing that can decrypt your bookmarks — on this device or a new one.
What if I lose my recovery code?
Your synced bookmarks can\'t be recovered — not by you, and not by us, because we never had the key. There is no password reset. Save the code somewhere safe; a password manager is ideal.
Do I need an account or email?
No. There\'s no sign-up, email, or phone number — just the recovery code. Nothing personal is tied to your bookmarks.
What if I don\'t want to use sync?
Sync is optional and off by default. You can always export your bookmarks to a file and import them later, with no server involved.
Permanently erase your encrypted bookmarks from the server

This permanently erases your encrypted bookmarks from the server and turns off sync on this device. The bookmarks on this device are kept. This can\'t be undone — other devices will no longer be able to restore from the server.
